title: kate-core: reload reapplies the file mode
summary: Reload rebuilds config through Document::from_loaded. Per-document edits since open are dropped. Each workspace test that opens a temp file writes root = true first. A parent .editorconfig cannot change that file. This packet does not edit modeline.rs. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Rebuild config and file through Document::from_loaded(name, ws.config.default_document.clone(), &new_text, file_state, None). Copy its config onto the reloaded document. Copy its file encoding onto the reloaded document. Do not call modeline functions directly. Reload restarts from default_document plus .editorconfig and the modeline. Per-document config changes made since open are dropped. pin_editorconfig writes a file named .editorconfig whose text is root = true. Call it before open in every workspace test that uses a temp directory. Do not weaken an existing assertion. Do not edit modeline.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::reload_reapplies_the_modeline_over_editorconfig
regression_tests.asserts: A temp .editorconfig sets indent_size 8 and root = true. Open a file with no modeline. indent_width is 8. Rewrite the file on disk with a modeline that sets indent-width 2. After Reload, indent_width is 2. Rewrite it again without the modeline. After Reload, indent_width is 8.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::open_ignores_a_parent_editorconfig
regression_tests.asserts: The file directory has root = true and no indent key. A parent indent_size of 8 does not change indent_width.
